description: This PHP file defines the class MyPipelineBySalesStageDashlet, a custom dashboard widget for SuiteCRM that displays a chart summarizing opportunities by sales stage. It extends DashletGenericChart, implements initialization, display options, data retrieval, and chart rendering logic specific to opportunities grouped by sales stage with date filters.

classes.name: MyPipelineBySalesStageDashlet
classes.description: A custom SuiteCRM dashboard dashlet to display opportunity pipeline by sales stage with chart visualization, filtering options, and data aggregation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet, sets default date range if not provided, and sets the title.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Displays the filtering options for sales stages in the dashlet.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates the chart visualization with JavaScript, based on data retrieved via constructed queries.

methods.name: getChartData
methods.description: Executes the data query, processes and orders the dataset based on selected sales stages.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds the SQL query to retrieve opportunity counts and totals grouped by sales stage and user within selected date range.

methods.name: constructGroupBy
methods.description: Defines the SQL GROUP BY clause fields.

methods.name: prepareChartData
methods.description: Processes raw dataset into structured data suitable for chart rendering, including labels, values, tooltips, and total.
